title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work | TechCrunch
summary: An OpenAI spokesperson told TechCrunch that while most users are not expected to face more frequent usage resets, a small fraction of its heaviest users may hit their limits sooner.
